judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the photo at the top of the Abraham Lincoln Birthplace result card. It sits inside a link whose text also gives the park name, designation and state. The crop and the screenshot show the neoclassical Memorial Building at the Lincoln birthplace site among trees. The page's find-a-park.js sets alt to the CMS alt text or, when that is empty, to park_name + " banner image". The park-finder API the page reads (checked live: same image, empty CMS alt) confirms this is the park's own banner image, so the alt is literally accurate. It is generic and repeats the card heading; alt="" or a short scene description would be better. But it describes nothing the image fails to show, so the claimed mismatch is not a 1.1.1 failure. The model had the image, the heading and the destination, and misjudged it.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the banner photo of the Acadia result card. It sits inside a link that also reads 'Acadia National Park Maine' and carries an image credit. The crop shows a pink-granite summit above a bay dotted with islands, the classic Cadillac Mountain view over Frenchman Bay. The live park-finder API confirms this is Acadia's own banner image (credit Alan Nyiri) with no CMS alt text, so the page falls back to 'Acadia banner image'. That alt is accurate, if terse and redundant with the heading. Nothing it says is absent from the image, so the claimed mismatch does not hold.
